verifiedCurrentEvidence.verification: Both immutable manifests and all captured raw artifacts were rehashed and re-parsed. Standard: 880 tests, services: 936 tests; zero failures/errors/skips; exit 0; candidate SHA and clean state match; every artifact SHA and manifest timestamp window verified. The complete root gates were not repeated.

counterprobes.hypothesis: A duplicate field assignment and an opaque sibling expression should block only their own targets, while an unrelated header option remains safely editable without touching the opaque or duplicate text.
counterprobes.novelty: Combines duplicate assignment, an opaque field value and a safe header edit in one snapshot; the phase tests cover these separately.
counterprobes.actions: Compiled and ran P3CounterProbe.java against the candidate core classes with a task containing two input assignments and mode=loadDynamicValue(); attempted SetField on input and mode, then SetTaskOption description.
counterprobes.expected: SetField input -> EDIT_MULTIPLE_ASSIGNMENTS; SetField mode -> EDIT_UNSAFE_REGION; no plans for either; SetTaskOption description -> ALLOWED with byte-preserved duplicate/opaque text and a current-only plan.
counterprobes.observed: Both unsafe fields were rejected with the expected codes, the description plan was allowed, the untouched text remained exact, and the plan validated as current for the original snapshot and stale for its postimage.

counterprobes.hypothesis: Rename must fail closed when a captured reference document is read-only, and succeed project-wide only when the document is editable.
counterprobes.novelty: Read-only reference-document boundary for project rename; phase tests cover project rename and open documents, but not this read-only reference path.
counterprobes.actions: Built a project with settings, a writable producer job and a second reference job; ran RenameSymbol once with the second job read-only and once editable.
counterprobes.expected: Read-only: REJECTED EDIT_READONLY with no plan. Editable: ALLOWED, one plan touching settings and both jobs with exact :a:renamed references and no doubled quotes.
counterprobes.observed: Read-only rename produced EDIT_READONLY and no plan; editable rename produced the expected three-document plan, exact references and updated settings defaults.

counterprobes.hypothesis: Any intent that writes a result-field reference should enforce the same port compatibility as BindResult.
counterprobes.novelty: Compares SetField and planConfiguration against BindResult on the identical snapshot with a path-output/text-input mismatch.
counterprobes.actions: Compiled and ran P3PortProbe.java with a Source output of shape path and a Sink input of shape text; invoked BindResult, SetField and planConfiguration.
counterprobes.expected: All three routes should reject the incompatible binding with EDIT_PORT_COMPATIBILITY, or SetField/planConfiguration should refuse the result-field value and require BindResult.
counterprobes.observed: BindResult was REJECTED with EDIT_PORT_COMPATIBILITY, but SetField and planConfiguration were ALLOWED and published input=result('p').file. This exposes P3-F1.

openMandatoryFindings.source: gretl-tooling-core/src/main/java/ch/so/agi/gretl/tooling/edit/FieldSourceEdits.java and SemanticEditPlanner.java accept EditableValue.ResultFieldRef without invoking PortCompatibility.require; DependencySourceEdits.bind and DeclarationSourceEdits.addTask do invoke it.
openMandatoryFindings.reproduction: Build a catalog with Source output file:path and Sink input input:text. Job: task('p', Source) {}; task('c', Sink, dependsOn:'p') { input='old' }. On one snapshot: BindResult(p,file,c,input) -> REJECTED EDIT_PORT_COMPATIBILITY; SetField(c,input,ResultFieldRef(p,file)) -> ALLOWED; planConfiguration(c,{input:ResultFieldRef(p,file)},...,{dependsOn:'p'}) -> ALLOWED. Both allowed plans contain input=result('p').file. Raw output: evidence/port-probe.log.
openMandatoryFindings.expected: Every route that writes a result-field reference must reject a producer output that is nullable, unknown or not shape-compatible with the consumer input, exactly as BindResult does; otherwise SetField must reject ResultFieldRef and require BindResult.
openMandatoryFindings.observed: SetField and planConfiguration publish an allowed plan for the incompatible path/text binding while BindResult rejects the identical binding. The postimage analyzer does not diagnose the mismatch, so the plan passes verification.
openMandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Apply PortCompatibility.require/dependencies to every ResultFieldRef written by SetField/planConfiguration, or disallow ResultFieldRef in SetField and route such changes through BindResult. Add negative tests for incompatible and nullable result outputs through both the direct SetField and form-configuration paths.

summary: FAIL: supplied standard/service gates validate (880/936 tests, clean candidate SHA) and the affected checks pass (475 Java tests), but SetField and planConfiguration bypass the result-port compatibility guard. A path-output/text-input binding is published as ALLOWED while BindResult rejects it with EDIT_PORT_COMPATIBILITY. P3-04, P3-05 and P3-08 are therefore not fulfilled; see P3-F1.
